create_parameter: create a Parameter object with name, nominal value, min and max bounds, and optional frozen flag
build_parameter_dict: build a ParameterDict collection of Parameter objects with vectorized access and serialization
test_parameter_update: test updating Parameter values from a flat vector and verifying bounds enforcement
review_parameter_dict_compare: review ParameterDict.compare_parameters to generate a color-coded table of initial, nominal, identified values with error metrics
summarize_parameter_dict_serialization: summarize ParameterDict.save_to_disk and load_from_disk for YAML-based parameter persistence
